description: Four small plastic cups in blue, yellow, red, and green sit on the table, with a yellow bottle off to the right. The left hand holds and tilts the red cup while the right hand brings a blue textured sponge to the cup’s opening, pushes it partway inside, then slides and twists it as if scrubbing the inner rim; the right hand briefly pulls the sponge back out and repositions it against the cup’s mouth while the left hand steadies the cup.
